notes.title: 🚀 Space Scum Playtest Update
notes.notes: [h1][b]🛰️ Incoming Transmission, Mercenaries![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]The galaxy just got a little safer and a little smarter. Version [b]0.6.5.16[/b] is live with plenty of fixes, smarter AI, and quality of life improvements that should make your battles more fair and your missions more reliable.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🔧 [b]Latest Patch Notes[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]💥 [b]Crash Fixes & Stability[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a crash when a crew member had more than 10 abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that could occur when opening a Robot Systems shop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game not fully closing on Steam[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠️ [b]Gameplay Fixes & QoL[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed characters appearing to have more Focus than they actually do due to rounding up[/p][/*][*][p]Status effects are no longer applied to downed characters in a tactical battle[/p][/*][*][p]Automated Sentries are no longer included in checks to see if a team has been wiped out in a tactical battle[/p][/*][*][p]Player crew members who are downed in battle now have a chance to survive at the end (provided they still have a head attached)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missions sometimes being created for non-existent enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missions not spawning or vanishing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hair turning white on characters that were downed in a tactical battle[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed footprints on the world map not saving or loading correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Game now auto pauses on load, when leaving a settlement or when closing the crew menu (settings menu toggles for these will come in a later update)[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎯 [b]Combat & Balance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed some area of effect attacks not correctly displaying their targeted tiles[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the difficulty display of some enemy packs on the world map not matching their actual difficulty[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemies using abilities when they did not have enough Focus[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some higher tier weapons not having the correct damage[/p][/*][*][p]Force Field and Armour Penetration now scales with the targets remaining Force Field or Armour[/p][/*][*][p]Durability of equipment has changed, lower quality items now have less and higher quality items now have more[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Shield item tooltip displaying unnecessary data[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧠 [b]AI Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]AI is now more aggressive when they or their team mates are targeted[/p][/*][*][p]AI should now know the requirements to use certain abilities[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛒 [b]Economy & Missions[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Mission reward money has been reworked, generally courier missions reward less[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that could make a courier missions secondary objective impossible[/p][/*][/list][h3]🖊️ [b]Miscellaneous[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed typos[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game rolling a D101 rather than a D100[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed line of sight issues with outdoor battles with elevations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]📡 [b]That's All For Now[/b][/h2][p]As always, keep sending us your thoughts through the [url="https://forms.gle/X4MHuVY8CMtARcA69"]Feedback Form[/url] (you can also find it in the Main Menu). Every report helps us improve Space Scum during the Playtest.[/p][p]And if you want to keep up with development, chat with the community, and talk directly to us, join us on [url="https://discord.gg/7xYdPN3UhP"]Discord[/url]![/p][p][/p][p][i]Until next time, stay scrappy and watch your six![/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Looking for more?[/b][/p][p]Another Forklift-published game [b]Roman Triumph[/b] has just launched in 1.0! 🏛️[/p][p]Build your city, defend it from invaders, please the gods, and see how long you can survive 👇🏻[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1864880/Roman_Triumph_Survival_City_Builder/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2601980/view/500584797655010475"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🚀 Space Scum Playtest Hotfix
notes.notes: [h3]Update 0.6.5.10[/h3][p]✅ Fixed settlement guards ending up with ever increasing name lengths after each battle[/p][p]✅ Fixed old saves crashing on load[/p][p][/p][h3]Update 0.6.5.11[/h3][p]✅ Fixed crash with AI at end of turns[/p][p][/p][h3]Update 0.6.5.12[/h3][p]✅ Fixed infinite focus gains when moving weapons to pack slots[/p][p]✅ Fixed too many Galactic Ascendant Captains spawning in packs[/p][p]✅ Sniper Rifle reload cost changed back from 8 to 6 [/p][p][/p][h3]Update 0.6.5.13[/h3][p]✅ Sniper Rifle reload cost changed back from 7 ap to 6 ap[/p][p]✅ Tactical Mark ability on Sniper Rifle changed from 7 ap to 5 ap[/p][p][/p][h3]Update 0.6.5.14[/h3][p]✅  Fixed infinite focus stat gains when saving and loading.[/p][p]✅  Fixed missions with inactive targets being offered in settlements.[/p][p]✅  Fixed Enforcer Robots not spawning with armour.[/p][p][/p][h3]Update 0.6.5.15[/h3][p]✅  Fixed crash using Drone shop on older save files.[/p][p]✅  Fixed wrong reload cost being checked when seeing if the reload ability is available to use.[/p][p]✅  Fixed Focus permanently being reduced when saving the game with weapons in pack slots[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3751340/view/519725096071333108"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🚀 Space Scum Playtest Day 17 Update
notes.notes: [h1]🛰️ [b]Mercenaries, Report In![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Thanks again to everyone taking part in the Space Scum Playtest and sharing your thoughts. Your reports keep helping us squash bugs and refine the game’s systems.[/p][p]Version [b]0.6.5.8[/b] is now live, it adds three new skills to master, smarter AI, balance tweaks, and plenty of bug fixes. Jump back in and see how the galaxy feels after this update![/p][hr][/hr][h2]🔧 [b]Latest Patch Notes[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]💥 [b]Crash Fixes & Stability[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a crash with an unknown weapon ID[/p][/*][*][p]Made sure status effects are always removed after a battle[/p][/*][*][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠️ [b]Gameplay Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed crew above level 3 not being checked for the main quest requiring the player to be level 3 or higher[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some elevation issues with AOE abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed characters on the map not changing their speed immediately after changing the game speed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed typos and text alignment errors[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎯 [b]New Skills & Abilities[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Side Step[/b] lets the user move freely this turn without triggering attacks of opportunity[/p][/*][*][p][b]Belt Trick[/b] allows a character to switch items from their pack once per turn for free[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dead Man’s Luck[/b] prevents the character from being critically hit[/p][/*][/list][h3]🤖 [b]Units & Drones[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Drones and Robot Drones have been combined and can now be equipped by either species[/p][/*][*][p]Robots no longer show morale indicators[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚔️ [b]Factions & NPC Variety[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Galactic Ascendants patrolling cities now spawn in greater numbers[/p][/*][*][p]Galactic Ascendants can now spawn away from cities[/p][/*][*][p]Galactic Ascendants, Scavengers, Mercenaries, and Yolihuani Empire now have additional backgrounds and equip additional types of armour and weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Many of these non-player backgrounds will not appear in game until day 3 to 5[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎯 [b]Weapon Balance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Sniper Rifle AP cost changed from 6 to 7[/p][/*][*][p]Sniper Reload cost changed from 6 to 8[/p][/*][*][p]Shotgun range changed from 6 to 7[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧠 [b]AI Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]AI reacts better when targeted[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]📡 [b]That's All For Now[/b][/h2][p]As always, keep sending us your thoughts through the [url="https://forms.gle/X4MHuVY8CMtARcA69"]Feedback Form[/url] (you can also find it in the Main Menu). Every report helps us improve Space Scum during the Playtest.[/p][p]And if you want to keep up with development, chat with the community, and talk directly to us, join us on [url="https://discord.gg/7xYdPN3UhP"]Discord[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time, keep on survivin’![/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Looking for more?[/b][/p][p]Another Forklift-published game [b]Roman Triumph[/b] has just launched in 1.0! 🏛️[/p][p]Build your city, defend it from invaders, please the gods, and see how long you can survive 👇🏻[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1864880/Roman_Triumph_Survival_City_Builder/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3751340/view/500584344614601417"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Space Scum Playtest Day 13 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]🛰️ Attention Mercenaries! [/h1][p][/p][p]Thanks again to everyone jumping into the Space Scum Playtest and sharing your feedback. Your reports are helping us squash bugs fast and smooth out the experience.[/p][p]We’ve just deployed [b]Version 0.6.5.3[/b], focusing on crash fixes, gameplay stability, and smarter AI behavior. Jump back in and let us know how it feels!
[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🔧 [b]Latest Patch Notes[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]💥 [b]Crash Fixes and Stability[/b][/h3][p]• Fixed crash when playing over 50 turns in a tactical battle[/p][p]• Fixed crash whilst dragging an inventory item and right clicking[/p][p]• Fixed crash when a player character is on the edge of the tactical battle map and the AI takes the next turn[/p][p][/p][h3]🛠️ [b]Gameplay Fixes[/b][/h3][p]• Fixed weapons in a character’s pack permanently increasing Focus when saving and loading[/p][p]• Fixed some tile costs in the tactical battle[/p][p]• Fixed manual saves being unexpectedly overwritten[/p][p]• Fixed health sometimes showing as 0 when it was actually slightly above 0[/p][p]• Fixed issues with accuracy display showing “Out of Range” or “Too Far”[/p][p][/p][h3]🤖 [b]AI Improvements[/b][/h3][p]• Improved the AI to not be as likely to “conga line”[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]📡 That's All For Now[/h3][p]As always, keep sending us your thoughts through the [url="https://forms.gle/X4MHuVY8CMtARcA69"]Feedback Form[/url] (you can also find it in the Main Menu). notes.title: Space Scum Playtest Day 10 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]🛰️ Attention Mercenaries! [/h1][p][/p][p]Thanks again to everyone jumping into the Space Scum Playtest and sharing your feedback. Your reports are helping us squash bugs fast and smooth out the experience.[/p][p]We’ve just deployed [b]Version 0.6.5.1[/b], focusing on stability fixes, balance tweaks, and quality of life improvements. Jump back in and let us know how it feels!
[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🔧 [b]Latest Patch Notes[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]💥 [b]Crash Fixes and Stability[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed duplication issue with the IDs of characters which could result in various bugs such as crew members being replaced by random shop recruits when loading[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crashes when entering battles[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crashes when receiving loot[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crashes during battles[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crashes when closing the game[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠️ [b]Gameplay Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed crew members health being restored to full when loading a game (sorry!)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Teleport ability sometimes failing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Create Barrier ability sometimes failing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some AoE attacks also hitting the attacker such as the Machine Gun Controlled Burst ability[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being able to repeatedly use the Brace ability on the Machine Gun[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being able to attempt to close a door when a character or corpse was on it resulting in lost AP[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed battles round number not resetting correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Stunned effect now removes Moving Target, Grappling, Brace and Shield Block effects from the target[/p][/*][*][p]Characters cannot receive Moving Target, Grappling, Brace and Shield Block effects whilst Stunned[/p][/*][/list][h3]🖥️ [b]Interface and Quality of Life[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed GUI menus overlapping when in a dungeon location[/p][/*][*][p]Setting an item to be repaired now also shows this in its tooltips icon[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now interact with their inventory items via right click in addition to double clicking or dragging items[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed decimal number errors on crew stat screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various typos[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚖️ [b]Balance Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Reduced the amount of enemies and locations on the world map[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced mission rewards but increased mission bonus rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced shop respawn times[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the damage of explosions from the environment and robots dying[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased the sell price of items[/p][/*][*][p]Sell price of items is now affected by that items durability[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧰 [b]Miscellaneous[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed Reload ability cost of Shotguns[/p][/*][*][p]Removed option to choose ultra wide resolution when the player did not have an ultra wide monitor[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]📡 That's All For Now[/h3][p][/p][p]As always, keep sending us your thoughts through the [url="https://forms.gle/X4MHuVY8CMtARcA69"]Feedback Form[/url] (you can also find it in the Main Menu). Every report helps us improve Space Scum during the Playtest.[/p][p][/p][p]And if you want to keep up with development, chat with the community, and talk directly to us, don’t forget to join us on [url="https://discord.gg/7xYdPN3UhP"]Discord[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time, keep on survivin’![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3751340/view/497205828189685467"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3751340/view/497205828189685297"][/dynamiclink][/p]
